title: Repair commands
description: Simple repair commands for easy tool and armour repairing.
body:
Repair Commands is a small Fabric mod that adds two simple server-side commands for repairing damaged gear.

## Commands

- `/repair` repairs the damaged item you are currently holding.
- `/repairall` repairs all damaged items in your inventory, including tools, weapons, armor, and other damageable items.

The mod works in singleplayer and on dedicated servers. On servers, it only needs to be installed server-side, so players can join with a vanilla client.
